verdict.rationale: Aider lets users get AI answers and analysis about their own data, here the codebase, inside the product. It offers /ask for code-base questions without edits and AI? comments in watch mode, and community users report it helped them understand unfamiliar codebases. This is user-initiated Q&A about code only, not proactive insight or suggestion generation over general user data. Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted AI insights and suggestions, insights over non-code data, and documentation of an insights or suggestions feature beyond ad-hoc Q&A.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: /ask Ask questions about the code base without editing any files.
AI? triggers aider to answer your question.
I've used aider to understand new codebases using technologies I don't know and it did a fantastic job
Aider can answer questions I can't search for via LSP, like 'what code would process the following URL' and similar.
